name: Zip Folders
description: Asks for a directory, then zips each of its subdirectories into its own archive (folder-name.zip, next to it by default), leaving out clutter (.DS_Store, .git, node_modules, __pycache__), checks every archive and reports what was done. Needs Python 3.8+: when Python is missing, only Python 2 is there or Python 3 is too old, it offers to install or upgrade it, or falls back to the system's zip tools.
